summary: Studio Lam was a beloved small Sukhumvit music bar and listening room known for molam, luk thung, Thai funk and adventurous international DJ sets. It permanently closed after its farewell event on 28 February 2026, so it will not be a December 2026 nightlife option.
whyGo: For visitors researching Bangkok's recent independent music history, Studio Lam was an influential intimate venue with a distinctive sound system and a programme connecting local artists and global grooves.
bestFor: Music fans seeking context on Bangkok's molam and underground club scene, or a historical stop while visiting the Sukhumvit 51 area.
skipIf: Skip as a planned bar, live show or club night: the venue has closed permanently and has no December 2026 programme.
duration: Not applicable as a venue visit; allow only a brief exterior look if already nearby, and do not expect access or activity.
cost: No admission or current venue prices; Studio Lam is closed. Any cost for nearby alternatives will depend on the venue and event.
hours: Permanently closed since 28 February 2026. Older listings showing Tuesday–Sunday evening hours are obsolete.
bestTime: No visit time applies. If passing through Sukhumvit 51, daytime is useful for seeing the area without mistaking the former bar for an operating venue.
gettingThere: The former address was 3/1 Sukhumvit 51, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, near BTS Thong Lo. Do not travel there specifically for nightlife; confirm any separate nearby destination before setting out.
booking: There are no Studio Lam bookings or events to make. Its final party took place on 28 February 2026.
accessibility: No visitor access information applies after closure. Historical sources describe an intimate bar but do not establish step-free access or other facilities.
practicalTips: Treat older guide pages, maps and social listings that show regular hours as outdated; the closure was announced in January and confirmed after the final night.
The founder's ZudRangMa Records continues, according to the farewell statement reproduced on the venue's page; check its own current channels for record-store information or related music activity.
decemberNotes: Studio Lam closed on 28 February 2026, so it will not be open during December 2026. No future reopening or replacement venue was announced in the sources checked. This entry is retained as a closure warning and a note on Bangkok's music history.
uncertainties: No current successor venue or December 2026 programme was announced in the sources reviewed.
